color.note: Signal (dark) is the default; Fog (light) is the second theme. Fog comes from Hangar's ROADMAP.md and mockups, not its tokens.json. Its green #016d52 and yellow #944d01 are proposed fixes still pending the owner, and its alphas were derived from Overview's, not reviewed. sg-base-* is the raw palette; components use the semantic layer. sg-overview-* tokens are dark only.

tokens.name: sg-base-bg
tokens.usage: Raw palette: page, title bar, status bar. Components read it through sg-surface-base.

tokens.name: sg-base-panel
tokens.usage: Raw palette: rails, panels, tooltips, toasts. Components read it through sg-surface-raised and sg-surface-overlay.

tokens.name: sg-base-side
tokens.usage: Raw palette: wells, inset controls, keycaps, sidebar. Components read it through sg-surface-sunken.

tokens.name: sg-base-line
tokens.usage: Raw palette: hairline dividers. Components read it through sg-border-subtle.

tokens.name: sg-base-line2
tokens.usage: Raw palette: control borders. Components read it through sg-border-default.

tokens.name: sg-base-sel
tokens.usage: Raw palette: selected row fill. Components read it through sg-surface-selected.

tokens.name: sg-base-fg
tokens.usage: Raw palette: ink. Components read it through sg-text-primary; canvas code uses it for the map lattice at low alpha.

tokens.name: sg-base-dim
tokens.usage: Raw palette: secondary text. Components read it through sg-text-secondary.

tokens.name: sg-base-faint
tokens.usage: Raw palette: decorative glyphs only, never readable text. It measures 2.9 to 3.6:1 on the surfaces in Signal and 2.5 to 3.1:1 in Fog, below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: sg-base-accent
tokens.usage: Raw palette: periwinkle (Signal) / iris (Fog), the owner's hand. Components read it through sg-accent-*, sg-border-focus and sg-text-link.

tokens.name: sg-base-green
tokens.usage: Raw palette: done. The Fog value #016d52 is a proposed fix still pending the owner (Hangar roadmap open question 7).

tokens.name: sg-base-yellow
tokens.usage: Raw palette: needs you, the loudest colour. The Fog value #944d01 is a proposed fix still pending the owner (Hangar roadmap open question 7).

tokens.name: sg-base-red
tokens.usage: Raw palette: failed.

tokens.name: sg-base-blue
tokens.usage: Raw palette: running, the faintest status.

tokens.name: sg-surface-base
tokens.usage: Content and page background; the title bar and status bar. Every text token except sg-text-disabled holds 4.5:1 on it in both themes.

tokens.name: sg-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Rails and panels; the segmented group's fill. The attention card and list rows sit on it.

tokens.name: sg-surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and inset controls: the button fill, keycaps.

tokens.name: sg-surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Tooltips, toasts, menus, callouts. Floating surfaces, so each pairs with its sg-shadow-* token.

tokens.name: sg-surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected list row fill, always with the 1px sg-accent-border inset ring. Hover never stacks on it.

tokens.name: sg-state-hover
tokens.usage: Row hover wash: ink at 4%.

tokens.name: sg-state-hover-control
tokens.usage: Hover wash on borderless controls: the ghost title-bar button and segmented cells. Ink at 6% (Overview's build; Hangar used 4%).

tokens.name: sg-state-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed wash: ink at 6%.

tokens.name: sg-text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, titles, names, commands, button labels. On sg-surface-base, -raised, -sunken and -selected it measures 11.2 to 14.2:1 in Signal and 12.4 to 15.5:1 in Fog.

tokens.name: sg-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Metadata, control labels, keycap text, status bar text, ghost button labels. On base, raised, sunken and selected it measures 6.0 to 7.6:1 in Signal and 4.7 to 5.9:1 in Fog.

tokens.name: sg-text-subtle
tokens.usage: Section heads, ages, paths, tags, tab labels, placeholders, map-label sub-text. On base, raised, sunken and selected it measures 4.9 to 6.3:1 in Signal and 4.7 to 5.9:1 in Fog; at least 4.8:1 on the attention card. In Fog it equals sg-text-secondary (#5b5e62), as Hangar specifies. Derived as mix(faint, dim, 0.72).

tokens.name: sg-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels, the "$" before a command, ambient marks. FAILS 4.5:1 and is kept from the source: 2.9 to 3.6:1 in Signal, 2.5 to 3.1:1 in Fog. Disabled controls are exempt; never set information in it.

tokens.name: sg-text-link
tokens.usage: Links. On base, raised, sunken and selected it measures 4.7 to 6.0:1 in Signal and 6.3 to 7.8:1 in Fog.

tokens.name: sg-text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid status or accent fill: the count badge's number on sg-status-wait-fg (10.6:1 Signal, 5.7:1 Fog); on sg-accent-solid 6.0:1 and 7.8:1. Aliases side in Signal and panel in Fog.

tokens.name: sg-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, tags, tab-bar and status-bar rules, segmented cell dividers. It is a divider, not a control edge (1.0 to 1.3:1).

tokens.name: sg-border-default
tokens.usage: Button, keycap, tooltip and toast edges, machine map labels. About 1.5:1, so it is decoration: use it only where the label identifies the control. Inputs and edge-only controls take sg-border-control.

tokens.name: sg-border-strong
tokens.usage: Control border on hover. 3.1 to 3.9:1 on every surface in both themes. Derived as mix(faint, dim, 0.08).

tokens.name: sg-border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs (.sg-input) and any control identified only by its edge. 3.4 to 3.9:1 on every surface in both themes, meeting WCAG 1.4.11.

tokens.name: sg-border-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a 2px solid outline at a 1px offset (sg-border-width-thick, sg-size-focus-offset), and the 2px ring on a selected attention card or dragged label. 4.7 to 6.0:1 in Signal, 6.3 to 7.8:1 in Fog.

tokens.name: sg-accent-fg
tokens.usage: Accent text and marks: the "you" tone (.sg-tone-you). Same contrast as sg-text-link.

tokens.name: sg-accent-solid
tokens.usage: Accent fills: checked controls, the caret. Text on it is sg-text-on-accent.

tokens.name: sg-accent-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: accent at 12%. Its label is sg-text-primary, at least 8.3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: sg-accent-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover: accent at 20% (Overview; Hangar 18%).

tokens.name: sg-accent-bg-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button fill when pressed: accent at 24%.

tokens.name: sg-accent-border
tokens.usage: Primary button border and the selected row's 1px inset ring: accent at 60% (Overview; Hangar 55%).

tokens.name: sg-selection-bg
tokens.usage: Text selection: accent at 30%. Selected text stays sg-text-primary.

tokens.name: sg-selection-bg-inactive
tokens.usage: Text selection in an unfocused region: ink at 14%.

tokens.name: sg-status-run-fg
tokens.usage: Running: the six-dot braille glyph and its label. The faintest status. On the surfaces it measures 8.7 to 11.1:1 in Signal and 4.6 to 5.8:1 in Fog. In the status bar the running count stays sg-text-secondary and only the glyph takes this colour.
